tools.name: get_esim_catalog
tools.description: Queries active travel eSIM data plans. Refines by destination name, country code, or query keywords (e.g. JP, Japan, Japan 100MB, Europe 10GB, USA 30 Days).

tools.name: get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Retrieves the official ConnectMeGuru grounding knowledge base, including installation guides, device compatibility, refund policies, and support escalation workflows.

tools.name: validate_coupon
tools.description: Validates a discount coupon code for checkout. Note: User login is mandatory to validate a coupon. If this returns a 401 Unauthorized error, you must inform the user that they need to log in (by sending an OTP using send_agent_otp) before they can apply a coupon.

tools.name: get_checkout_url
tools.description: Generates a secure checkout and purchase link for a specific eSIM package.

tools.name: send_agent_otp
tools.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP code to the customer's email address for in-chat authentication.

tools.name: verify_agent_otp
tools.description: Verifies the email OTP code and returns a session token for wallet purchases.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Retrieves the user's current pre-funded wallet balance. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: purchase_esim_with_wallet
tools.description: Purchases an eSIM package directly in chat using the user's wallet balance. If balance is insufficient, returns a magic link to top-up.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels an eligible eSIM order before activation/provisioning. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: refresh_esim_usage
tools.description: Requests a real-time data usage update for an active eSIM from the carrier. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: get_wallet_transactions
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of wallet transaction history. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: get_topup_packages
tools.description: Retrieves compatible top-up data packages for an active eSIM. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: purchase_topup
tools.description: Purchases a compatible top-up package using the wallet balance. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: get_user_orders
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the authenticated user's eSIM orders and history. Requires a valid session token.

tools.name: get_available_coupons
tools.description: Retrieves currently active official ConnectMeGuru promotional coupon codes affiliated with admin@connectmeguru.com with their descriptions and applicability (e.g. general vs mobile app exclusive). Never invent fake codes or reveal third-party affiliate codes. Skip codes starting with SAVE20.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_url · Private data: verify_agent_otp, get_wallet_balance, purchase_esim_with_wallet, cancel_order, refresh_esim_usage, get_wallet_transactions, get_topup_packages, purchase_topup, get_user_orders · Public sink: send_agent_otp, verify_agent_otp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_url · Private data: verify_agent_otp, get_wallet_balance, purchase_esim_with_wallet, cancel_order, refresh_esim_usage, get_wallet_transactions, get_topup_packages, purchase_topup, get_user_orders · Public sink: send_agent_otp, verify_agent_otp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
